name: smwmusic-mega-man-x6-filled-with-rage-blaze-heatnix-s-stage-remix
title: Mega Man X6 - Filled with Rage ~ Blaze Heatnix's Stage (Remix)
description:
Been meaning to do a remix of Blaze Heatnix's stage from Mega Man X6 (aka the stage where you fight a Donut five times). This entire soundtrack in general is just filled with nothing but slappers, and I really wish the game got the same kind of treatment... instead of being the frustrating mess it is.

This bad boy is great for caves (lava themed ones), castles / towers, factories, intense stages, final areas, and [final] boss fights.

Important:
There is a "!READ ME.txt" file that has the sample bank. You'll need to move what's in that file into "Addmusic_sample_groups.txt."

There are also 2 customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C# Minor (Remix Pitch, turned on default)
2. B Minor (Custom Pitch)
